No name and no email: this phone gets an anonymous code, protected inside the phone itself.

I use HINT 365, a blood-pressure diary: you photograph the monitor or say the values, and it prepares the report for the doctor. Download it for Android: %1$s — open the file, allow the installation, then tap \"Sign in with Google\".
Sign in with your Google account. It is used only to create your diary and to find it again if you change phone. Every day the app opens with your fingerprint or face.

What is saved: an encrypted fingerprint of your Google account, without the email (only to find your diary again), your readings with their date and time, and whether each came from a photo or your voice. Photos of the monitor are sent to Anthropic to read the numbers and are not kept by this app. Data is stored on Cloudflare servers in the European Union; other users cannot see it; the person who runs the service can reach the database only for maintenance. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from the Admin tab. These are health data: by accepting you give your explicit consent to their processing (GDPR Art. 9, Swiss FADP), which you can withdraw by deleting your account.

Purpose and medical limits
HINT 365 is a personal diary for recording blood pressure and confirmed lab results and displaying their history. It does not measure, diagnose, judge whether values are normal or recommend treatment. Your doctor assesses the results. Never change treatment because of the app. For an emergency contact a doctor or emergency services (144 in Switzerland, 112 in Europe).

Personal use and accuracy
One account is one person. Record readings and upload lab reports only of yourself, the holder of this account: never of another person. HINT 365 does not know whose data they are and cannot tell them apart, so data of someone else would mix with your history. Reading by voice, from a photo of the monitor and from documents can be wrong or incomplete. Check blood-pressure values before saving, and lab results against the original report before relying on them or sharing them. Protect your phone with a screen lock. Sharing a PDF or link is a deliberate action by you; a recipient can keep or forward it.

Account, storage and providers
Sign in with Google uses OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect. HINT 365 does not receive your Google password. The server stores an HMAC of your Google account identifier, not your email. Confirmed pressure readings are stored with your account in Cloudflare D1 in the EU for up to 365 days and purged daily; lab results stay until you delete them (never automatically). Both they are pseudonymized, not anonymous. Google recovery reconnects your synchronized history. Blood pressure is recorded by voice or with a photo of the monitor. The phone’s speech service may use its own network processing. The photo Scan reads the monitor display with artificial intelligence. Up to 3 Scans a day are free: the photo of the display goes through HINT 365's server to Anthropic (Claude), which reads the three numbers for HINT 365 and does not use them to train its models; the server passes the photo on without storing or logging it, and the photo carries no name or account. For more Scans, up to 30 a day, you can add the API key of your own AI subscription (Claude by Anthropic, ChatGPT by OpenAI, Gemini by Google or Kimi by Moonshot): the key stays only on your phone, encrypted, and the photo then goes directly from your phone to that provider under its own terms. In every case the numbers read are shown to you and saved only if you confirm them, and the photo is then deleted from the phone. Only the three numbers you confirmed are stored by HINT 365. Acceptance records are retained as evidence after account deletion; technical error codes are retained for 90 days without free-text messages. Details and rights are described in the privacy policy. The web uses only the technical session cookie hint_s (seven days) and the stored cookie choice; Android uses no cookies.

Costs
The subscription, when enabled, costs 5 USD per year or the amount displayed by Google Play, paid to the app owner. It renews until canceled in Google Play; canceling leaves the paid period active. Google Play manages payment and refunds. Until enabled, the app is free. HINT 365 has no other charges: the 3 daily Scans are paid by the app owner; if you add your own AI key for more Scans, their use is charged by your AI provider on your own subscription.

Availability, responsibility and acceptance
The service may have outages and require updates. Unsupported app versions may be disabled for security. Nothing in these terms excludes statutory rights or the provider’s mandatory responsibilities. You can delete individual records or your account in the app, and exercise the rights explained in the privacy policy. By accepting, you confirm you are at least 18 and agree to these terms. Consent to storing your health data is requested separately and can be withdrawn by deleting your account. Acceptance and health-data consent are recorded with account, document version, language, text hash, app version and time.

Lab report import and history
Where the data are. At rest, the document stays only on your phone, wherever you keep it: PDFs and photos selected in Lab results are read and processed exclusively on the phone, and temporary copies are deleted after processing. In transit, the document never leaves the phone: only the report date and the results as printed (test, value, unit, reference interval) and a keyed fingerprint of the file travel, over HTTPS, an encrypted connection (TLS; Cloudflare uses TLS 1.3 when the phone supports it), each request also signed with a key kept on the phone, without name, surname, date of birth or any other reference to the person. On the server, only these are stored, linked to your pseudonymous account. They are pseudonymized, not anonymous: they carry no name, but they are linked to your account and remain health data under the GDPR and the Swiss FADP. The document on your phone, and the phone itself, remain your responsibility (screen lock, backups, apps you share it with). The results are saved automatically only when the whole document was read with certainty: one report date and every result line understood; otherwise nothing is saved. The same file, or the same test on the same date, is never saved twice. Only the test code or the test name as printed, value, unit, reference interval, report date and a keyed fingerprint of the file (used only to recognize the same file again) are stored with your account, also for an older report, until you delete them: a date on the web, a report in the app, all lab results on the web, or your whole account. They are never deleted automatically, so your history stays complete; they are available on the web and on a replacement phone. A result outside the reference printed on the same report is shown in orange with an arrow: this compares numbers only and is not a medical assessment. You are responsible for selecting only your own reports, protecting your phone and checking the results against the original. Extraction may be incomplete or incorrect and does not provide medical interpretation. This responsibility does not exclude the provider’s applicable obligations. Results are compared only within the same test and unit; no diagnosis or treatment recommendation is provided.
